rationale: Third party (neighbor's child) suffered injury on policyholder's property from a hazardous condition (icy walkway), establishing premises liability.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered broken wrist after slipping on icy walkway at policyholder's residence during ice storm; parents anticipating medical bills.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on ice
